title: Cold Storage Form
subtitle: Cold Storage Control: captures actual activity and handoff.
description: Cold Storage Form covers storage room, zone, product lot, monitoring device, door event, alarm, and disposition. The cold-storage operations owner records Cold Storage Control activity, quantities, variance, and handoff. Cold Storage Form keeps Cold Storage Control exceptions visible until the cold-storage operations owner handoff.
use_case: Use Cold Storage Form at cooler, freezer, cold room, loading interface, and affected product zone. Document storage room, zone, product lot, monitoring device, door event, alarm, and disposition identity before Cold Storage Control begins. Compare storage room, zone, product lot, monitoring device, door event, alarm, and disposition findings with stated Cold Storage Control criteria; route unresolved Cold Storage Control issues to qualified product-condition reviewer. For Cold Storage Form, confirm requirements for Cold Storage Control. Ask qualified product-condition reviewer to review Cold Storage Control conditions beyond the cold-storage operations owner's role.
